rationale: The last two candles are strongly bullish (26.55→26.70 and a high of 26.77), recovering the entire intraday decline and printing a new session high that effectively tests the original invalidation at $26.80; the maximum favorable excursion of 0.93% was not captured and price has since reversed, indicating the distribution thesis did not follow through.
